RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: not reliably estimable from the information provided

An all-women panel is not, by itself, evidence that sex influenced the decision. Neither does the successful candidate being a woman rule discrimination out. A numerical probability would be misleading.

Your longer experience warrants asking how it was assessed, but years served need not outweigh digital expertise or other selection criteria.

Follow up now on your written request. Ask for the criteria, their weighting, your assessment against them, and the applicable recruitment and review procedures. Panel composition becomes worth raising if it breached a specific policy or accompanies concrete evidence of bias—not simply because all four members were women.

If you may challenge the appointment, check local deadlines promptly.
